subject: Sea Shrine
text: Stepping on the panel behind Kraken recharges the Orb and exits the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote: Once Kraken is defeated, step on the panel behind him to recharge the Orb, and to get a free exit out of the Sea Shrine.

subject: Black Orb
text: When the four orbs are restored, the black orb disappears where Garland was fought, opening a time gate to 2,000 years in the past.

evidence.quote: Head to the place where you fought Garland, and if the four orbs are restored, the black orb will disappear, opening a time gate to which leads to 2,000 years in the past.

subject: Gas Dragon
text: Gas Dragons are weak to Ice.

evidence.quote: They are weak to Ice however, so keep this in mind if you have to fight.

subject: Floor 3 plate
text: Using the Lute removes the plate on Floor 3 to allow continued descent into the temple.

evidence.quote: If not, its the Lute which the Princess gave to you after saving her from Garland. If you don't have the Lute, exit the temple, and return to the castle and Coneria, and talk to the Princess and she'll give you the Lute.

subject: Lich
text: Lich guards the staircase heading down on Floor B1 and can use the Nuke spell.

evidence.quote: Lich now has his own fight location, and moving to the staircase will result in a fight with him every time. This Lich is now harder than the first time you fought him in the Earth Cave, and he can now use the Nuke Spell.

subject: Floor B2 chest
text: A chest on Floor B2 contains a ProRing.

evidence.quote: ...should you decide to chase the chests on this floor, which hold a ProRing, ProCape, Katana, and 26,000 GP.

subject: Floor B2 chest
text: A chest on Floor B2 contains a ProCape.

evidence.quote: ...should you decide to chase the chests on this floor, which hold a ProRing, ProCape, Katana, and 26,000 GP.

subject: Floor B2 chest
text: A chest on Floor B2 contains a Katana.

evidence.quote: ...should you decide to chase the chests on this floor, which hold a ProRing, ProCape, Katana, and 26,000 GP.

subject: Floor B2 chest
text: A chest on Floor B2 contains 26,000 GP.

evidence.quote: ...should you decide to chase the chests on this floor, which hold a ProRing, ProCape, Katana, and 26,000 GP.

subject: Kary
text: On Floor B2, Kary can deliver 2-6 hits and cast Fir3.

evidence.quote: Kary still has the little thing going with the huge number of monster hits 2-6 and she can now use Fir3.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken on Floor B3 can execute between 5-8 attacks and uses Lit2 and Ink.

evidence.quote: Kraken hasn't gained anything in terms of spells since you last fought him, but now he uses Lit2 (shouldn't this work against him?) and Ink which acts like Dark. His main threat comes from the amount of attacks that he can get. He'll get anywhere between 5-8 and can cause a couple of hundred damage to anyone.

subject: Floor B4 chest
text: Inside a building on Floor B4, a treasure chest contains the Masmune.

evidence.quote: Continue following this path, and you'll come to a building with the Masmune in it. This is the ultimate weapon in the game, surpassing even the Xcalber in damage, and anyone can use it.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat on Floor B4 has about 1,000 HP and can be defeated in one hit with Bane or Brak.

evidence.quote: You can still wipe him out in one hit with either Bane or Brak, but he seems to be more resistant to it now....His 1,000 HP or so means you'll have to cast Fast on yourself to defeat him quickly.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has 2000 HP and no elemental weaknesses.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos uses spells including Fir3, Ice3, Lit3, Cur4, Quake, Fast, and Inferno, and can stun party members with physical hits.

evidence.quote: Chaos uses just about every trick in the book including Fir3, Ice3, Lit3, Cur4, Crack (Quake), Fast, Inferno, (whatever the heck that is) and he hits pretty hard and can Stun your party members after hitting them.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos can cast Cur4 at any time to fully restore all 2,000 HP.

evidence.quote: You must also plan ahead, because Chaos can and will use Cur4 at any time, fully restoring his 2,000 HP to full.

subject: Floor 3 chest
text: The chest on the right contains 65,000 gold.

evidence.quote: If you want to fight him two more times, you can go for the chests, both of which contain large amounts of gold, (65,000 on the right, 45,000 on the left) or you can proceed to the plate.

subject: Floor 3 chest
text: The chest on the left contains 45,000 gold.

evidence.quote: If you want to fight him two more times, you can go for the chests, both of which contain large amounts of gold, (65,000 on the right, 45,000 on the left) or you can proceed to the plate.
